ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the diagram below, what do humans eat?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food chain relationship diagram. On the left there is “Leaves & Algae”, with arrows pointing to Mayflies, Stoneflies and Caddis Flies; the arrows of these organisms then point to “Trout”. On the right, beside “Trout” there is an arrow pointing to “Humans”. Reasoning: In a food chain diagram, arrows point from the organism that is eaten to the organism that eats it. Because the arrow goes from “Trout” to “Humans”, humans eat trout.
